description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) to planning permission reference: 2025/01396/FUL dated 5th September 2025 for the "Erection of a rear infill extension, to the side of existing second floor back addition, including raising the roof height, and alterations to the existing balustrade on top of the flat roof; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side of existing back addition; re-sizing and replacement of an existing window, to the rear elevation of existing rear roof extension; raising the height of the parapet wall, and repositioning of an existing window to the side elevation of first floor back addition; replacement of existing French doors with new metal framed Crittall doors, to the rear elevation at ground floor level." Amendments sought to include erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
